text:
tasha: PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/45221|#45221> blocked — failing integration test on dedicated GPU (context-window-leak). Can't repro locally. Anyone with access to the gpu pool able to run a targeted rerun on shard 7? cc @sam
ci-bot: Buildkite failure: pipeline/integration-gpu shard=7 — exit code 1
ci-bot: test: tests/integration/test_context_window.py::test_kv_retention — failed (OOM-ish stack trace)
sam: I can kick it. will run targeted rerun. does this need a full matrix or just shard 7?
tasha: just shard 7 for now. log shows repeated "KVCache exceeded max_entries" before the crash. not a snapshot diff AFAICT.
alex: go for it — no snapshot update expected. :thumbsup:
sam: running command:
```
./tools/ci/targeted_rerun --pr 45221 --shard 7 --pool dedicated-gpu
```
sam: queued the job, buildkite id 987-retry
ci-bot: build 987-retry started on gpu-node-14
maria: quick question — do we want to flip the env var `KV_CACHE_SOFT_LIMIT=1` to try a mitig? might hide root cause.
tasha: don't modify envs in PR reruns; we'll file an issue if it keeps happening. thanks though.
sam: rerun finished — passed on shard 7 :tada:
ci-bot: all checks green for PR #45221 (after targeted rerun)
jon: can someone give a quick approve so this doesn't sit? it's a minor refactor.
tasha: @alex can you approve? last LGTM was on code but needs review for merge window.
alex: LGTM, approving now. merging when CI green :white_check_mark:
jon: created ticket for flaky test tracking: <https://jira.internal/redwood/browse/ENG-3245|ENG-3245> — added logs and repro notes
tasha: thanks all! leaving note in the PR with the rerun id and the ticket link.
